providers.name: SpectralHilbert
providers.statement: abbrev SpectralHilbert := Lp ℂ 2 (volume : Measure ℝ)

providers.name: bounded_spectral_multiplier_nonneg
providers.statement:
theorem bounded_spectral_multiplier_nonneg (w : ℝ → ℝ) (hw : Continuous w)
    (hb : ∀ x, ‖w x‖ ≤ 1) (hn : ∀ x, 0 ≤ w x) :
    0 ≤ boundedSpectralMultiplier w hw hb

providers.name: continuous_modular_graph_iff
providers.statement:
theorem continuous_modular_graph_iff (c : ℝ) (f g : SpectralHilbert) :
    (f,g) ∈ (continuousModularOperator c).graph ↔
      g =ᵐ[volume] fun x => (Real.exp (-c * x) : ℂ) * f x

decision: ADAPTAR only vector-valued multiplier positivity; REUSAR bounded/resolvent graph infrastructure
reason: SpectralHilbert is fixed to Lp Complex 2 volume. The present consumer is Lp (TowerHilbert P) 2 volume. No existing isometry/intertwiner identifies those multiplication representations. Do not substitute by homonym or assume equal Hilbert-space dimensions preserve the core.
not_reproved: Graph/domain/selfadjointness theorems are consumed from generic resolventGraphOperator. Existing scalar construction remains unchanged.
